# CloudFormation Authoring and Lint Skill

## Use This Skill When
- Generating or repairing CloudFormation YAML.

## Rules
- Enforce AWSTemplateFormatVersion and YAML formatting conventions.
- Apply tagging and encryption defaults.
- Treat cfn-lint failures as blocking.
- Propose secure checkov remediations without privilege expansion.

See common-fixes.md for recurring lint/scan corrections.
